panels.title: Batarya sağlığı
panels.description: Mevcut kullanılabilir kapasitenin referans kapasiteye oranı. Mevcut = son 10 kapasite tahmininin medyanı. Göstergenin içindeki çizgi bu değerin tüm geçmişidir.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100),
capref AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('$reference_kwh'), ''), '0')::float8,
          (SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM cap)
        ) AS ref,
        NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('$reference_kwh'), ''), '0') IS NOT NULL
          AS manual)
SELECT s.t AS time, r.med * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT ref FROM capref), 0) AS health
FROM cap s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) AS med
  FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap c2 WHERE c2.t <= s.t
        ORDER BY c2.t DESC LIMIT 10) z) r
WHERE s.t <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 100 $length_unit başına şarj maliyeti
panels.description: Dönemde şarja harcanan paranın, dönemde sürülen mesafeye bölümü. Maliyeti olmayan seanslar sıfır sayılır. Küçük yüzde, seçili dönemin hemen öncesindeki aynı uzunluktaki döneme göre değişimdir.

targets.rawSql:
WITH periods AS (
        SELECT n, t0, t1 FROM (VALUES
          (1, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - (($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')), ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
          (2, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))) v(n, t0, t1)),
chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Bilinmiyor') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL)
SELECT p.t1 AS time, m.* FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (SELECT SUM(cost) FROM chg WHERE start_date >= p.t0 AND start_date < p.t1) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT convert_km((SUM(km))::numeric, '$length_unit') FROM drv WHERE start_date >= p.t0 AND start_date < p.t1), 0) AS "cost100__$currency") m ORDER BY p.n

panels.title: Park gününde kaybedilen menzil
panels.description: Araç park halindeyken, 24 saatlik park başına kaybolan menzil. Arada şarj olan parklar dışarıda bırakılır. Küçük yüzde, seçili dönemin hemen öncesindeki aynı uzunluktaki döneme göre değişimdir.

WITH periods AS (
        SELECT n, t0, t1 FROM (VALUES
          (1, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - (($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')), ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
          (2, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))) v(n, t0, t1)),
eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
park AS (
        SELECT x.t0, x.t1, x.temp, x.geofence_id, x.address_id,
               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x.t1 - x.t0)) / 3600.0 AS hours,
               GREATEST(x.p0 - x.p1, 0)::float8 AS loss_km,
               (GREATEST(x.r0 - x.r1, 0) * eff.e)::float8 AS loss_kwh
        FROM (
          SELECT d.end_date AS t0, LEAD(d.start_date) OVER w AS t1,
                 d.end_rated_range_km AS r0,
                 LEAD(d.start_rated_range_km) OVER w AS r1,
                 d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km AS p0,
                 LEAD(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) OVER w AS p1,
                 COALESCE((d.outside_temp_avg
                   + LEAD(d.outside_temp_avg) OVER w) / 2,
                   d.outside_temp_avg) AS temp,
                 d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id,
                 d.end_address_id AS address_id
          FROM drives d
          WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY d.start_date)) x
        CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE x.t1 IS NOT NULL AND x.r0 IS NOT NULL AND x.r1 IS NOT NULL
          AND x.t1 - x.t0 BETWEEN interval '1 hour' AND interval '30 days'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes c
            WHERE c.car_id = $car_id AND c.start_date < x.t1
              AND COALESCE(c.end_date, c.start_date) > x.t0))

CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT convert_km((SUM(loss_km))::numeric, '$length_unit') * 24 / NULLIF(SUM(hours), 0)::numeric AS "loss__${length_unit}_day" FROM park WHERE t0 >= p.t0 AND t0 < p.t1) m ORDER BY p.n

                 LEAD(d.start_rated_range_km) OVER w AS r1,
                 d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km AS p0,
                 LEAD(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) OVER w AS p1,
                 COALESCE((d.outside_temp_avg
                   + LEAD(d.outside_temp_avg) OVER w) / 2,
                   d.outside_temp_avg) AS temp,
                 d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id,
                 d.end_address_id AS address_id
          FROM drives d
          WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY d.start_date)) x
        CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE x.t1 IS NOT NULL AND x.r0 IS NOT NULL AND x.r1 IS NOT NULL
          AND x.t1 - x.t0 BETWEEN interval '1 hour' AND interval '30 days'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes c
            WHERE c.car_id = $car_id AND c.start_date < x.t1
              AND COALESCE(c.end_date, c.start_date) > x.t0)),
chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Bilinmiyor') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL

        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100)
SELECT COALESCE((drain > 2)::int, 0) + COALESCE((eff < 85)::int, 0)
         + (unpriced > 0)::int + COALESCE((age > 60)::int, 0) AS status,
       drain, eff, unpriced, age
FROM (SELECT
  (SELECT (SUM(loss_kwh) FILTER (WHERE t0 >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '7 days')
            / NULLIF(SUM(hours) FILTER (WHERE t0 >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '7 days'), 0))

     FROM park WHERE t0 >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '90 days') AS drain,
  (SELECT SUM(added) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(used), 0) FROM chg
     WHERE start_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '30 days') AS eff,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chg WHERE cost IS NULL
     AND start_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '90 days') AS unpriced,
  (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - MAX(t))) / 86400 FROM cap) AS age) x

panels.title: Mesafe ve 100 $length_unit başına şarj maliyeti
panels.description: Alan: her ay sürülen mesafe (sol eksen). Çizgi: o ayın 100 mesafe birimi başına şarj maliyeti (sağ eksen); 100 birimden az sürülen aylarda gösterilmez. Seçili zaman aralığı ne olursa olsun her zaman 12 ay gösterir.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Bilinmiyor') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
m AS (SELECT generate_series(
        date_trunc('month', (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone') - interval '11 months'),
        date_trunc('month', (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')), interval '1 month') AS mon),
d AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', ((start_date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')) AS mon,
             SUM(km) AS km FROM drv GROUP BY 1),
c AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', ((start_date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')) AS mon,
             SUM(cost) AS cost FROM chg GROUP BY 1)
SELECT ((m.mon) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone') AS time,
       convert_km((COALESCE(d.km, 0))::numeric, '$length_unit') AS "distance__$length_unit",
       CASE WHEN convert_km((d.km)::numeric, '$length_unit') >= 100 THEN c.cost * 100 / convert_km((d.km)::numeric, '$length_unit') END
         AS "cost100__$currency"
FROM m LEFT JOIN d USING (mon) LEFT JOIN c USING (mon) ORDER BY 1
